hints.acceptedAnswers: Answers are graded automatically only when accepted answers are listed. Leave this empty and student answers go to you for grading.
hints.blankTokens: Write the blanks in the question text first. A blank is its own name between double braces, for example b1.
hints.fillInBlank: Type the accepted answer for each blank. Separate accepted spellings with ~ and the student only needs to write one of them.
hints.matching: Write each item next to its match. At least {{min}} pairs are needed, and the matches are shuffled for the student.
hints.multipleSelect: Tick every option that is correct. The student has to select all of the ticked options and nothing else.
hints.ordering: Write the steps in the correct order. Between {{min}} and {{max}} steps are allowed, and they are shuffled for the student.
hints.passage: The text shown above the question. It is frozen into a student attempt, so a later edit does not change an attempt already started.

numericModes.relative: Within a percent of the value

validation.objectiveAnswersFew: Question {{index}}: tick at least two options as correct.

validation.objectiveOptionsMany: Question {{index}}: six options is the maximum.
validation.orderItemsDistinct: Question {{index}}: every step needs its own wording.
validation.orderItemsFew: Question {{index}}: an ordering question needs at least three steps.

validation.pairsFew: Question {{index}}: a matching question needs at least two complete pairs.
validation.pairsIncomplete: Question {{index}}: every pair needs an item and its match.
validation.validCorrectOption: Question {{index}}: select a valid correct option.
